name: Control transport forensics
queries: Why are founder CEOs becoming harder for boards to remove?
notes: The same verified control as control_latency_forensics, with httpcore phase tracing added. The request is byte-identical - same Sonnet 5 model, saved founder_ceos packet, system prompt, 220-token ceiling and 25-word chunk rule, still no thinking and no output_config - and a golden-request test pins that. Tracing subscribes to httpcore's trace extension, which is client-side metadata and never reaches the wire. It splits the previous single transport bucket into DNS+TCP, TLS, upload and wait-for-headers, and records whether each trial reused a pooled connection.
